summary: Thin linear wrapper: casts the code address of the following null subroutine nullsub_151 (0x0044DB60) to int and passes it to BooleanToIntConversion, returning the conversion result. Because the address is a fixed non-null constant, the function returns a constant non-zero (boolean true) value; the legacy ABI name suggests it reports whether a collision-data registration block is present, but the body itself carries no branching or flag read.
